name: Card
description: A bounded surface that groups related content, with an optional header and footer.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading at the top of the card. Rendered as an h3.

props.name: footer
props.description: Actions or meta at the bottom, separated from the content.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Adds hover and focus styles for cards that act as a single link or button.

a11y: The title renders as an h3 so cards in a list form a readable outline.
An interactive card wraps one link or button; don't nest other interactive elements inside it.
Hover and focus styles never rely on color alone: the border changes too.
